author: N.G Martin, Hugo

steps.title: Fix and quench cells
steps.instruction: After isolation, fix 1 × 10⁶ cells in 1 % formaldehyde for 14 min, then add glycine to a final concentration of 125 mM and incubate for 1 min to quench.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 % formaldehyde to the cell suspension and incubate 14 min at room temperature.
Add glycine to reach 125 mM and incubate 1 min.

steps.title: Wash and harvest cells
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed cells three times with PBS containing complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, 11836145001) and 10 mM sodium butyrate (Sigma‑Aldrich, 303410), then harvest by scraping from the plates.

substeps.instruction: Prepare wash buffer: PBS + protease inhibitor cocktail + 10 mM sodium butyrate.
Perform three washes of the cell pellet with the buffer.
Scrape cells from the culture plates to collect them.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei using Covaris
steps.instruction: Resuspend washed cells and isolate nuclei on a Covaris E220 for 4.5 min at peak power 75 W, duty factor 2 % and 200 cycles/burst.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate chromatin
steps.instruction: For each IP, add 2 µg of the appropriate antibody and protein A/G Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific, 88802) to an equal amount of chromatin per sample and incubate under the conditions described in Arrigoni 2018 (no barcode ligation or pooling).

substeps.instruction: Measure an equal amount of chromatin for each sample (quantify by Nanodrop).
Add 2 µg antibody to each sample.
Add protein A/G Dynabeads and incubate as per the referenced protocol.

steps.title: Quantify chromatin and DNA
steps.instruction: Measure chromatin concentration with a Nanodrop (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and quantify the immunoprecipitated DNA with a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific) before library preparation.

substeps.instruction: Use Nanodrop to determine chromatin concentration.
Use Qubit 4 to quantify the IP DNA.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Construct libraries using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit (NEB, E7645S) and assess library quality and quantity with an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

substeps.instruction: Follow the NEBNext Ultra kit protocol to generate libraries.
Run the finished libraries on a BioAnalyzer for QC.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq instrument with 150 bp paired‑end reads.
